item.title: Lahore Sets the Pace: Smart Traffic Signals to Transform 20 Major Spots
item.description: LAHORE — The Traffic Engineering & Transport Planning Agency (TEPA) has launched a major initiative to modernize traffic management in Lahore. The project has received approval from the Punjab Cabinet and is supported by the provincial government. It will involve installing smart traffic systems and pelican (pedestrian-activated) signals at 20 key intersections across the city. item.title: Karachi Police to Crack Down on Illegal Number Plates This Friday
item.description: Karachi — Starting this Friday, Karachi Police will launch a citywide operation targeting illegal, fake, and concealed number plates. The crackdown, which will involve district police, Karachi Traffic Police, the Excise and Taxation Department, and the Citizens-Police Liaison Committee (CPLC), aims to address the growing issue of number plate tampering to evade traffic enforcement.
